title: [GMCP 203.045.01] Contract: Official conformance and ecosystem interoperability matrix
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-045-01. Translate the mastery target into a normative clause and behavior table. Pin source revisions and hashes; define canonical APIs and data models, compatibility and deprecation decisions, threat model, measurable SLO or resource budgets, positive and negative fixtures, and immutable evidence locations. Resolve every ambiguity before implementation. Vector outcome: Pinned official MCP conformance suites pass with zero expected failures for GMCP as client and server on every supported revision, transport and official extension. Differential tests against representative reference SDKs and major hosts/servers run in both directions on every platform; the published compatibility matrix contains no unexplained cell, and upstream suite changes block release until classified. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
